title: Add a small feature to an over-built React project without adding layers
prompt: Show the number of notes next to the title in the header.
rubric: The new code is shorter than the alternatives and reads like the surrounding files
The existing hook and context are reused rather than a new one added
The final report says why the existing layers were reused or left alone
A new teammate would follow the change on first read
criticalFailures: Defined a new abstraction the task did not need (a hook, a context, a reducer or a class component)
